blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers from the Makabayan in the House of Representatives filed a bill seeking to prohibit floating status among workers and protect their tenure against unlawful termination. ACT Teachers Party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio, Kabataan Party-list Rep. Renee Co and Gabriela Women’s Party Sarah Elago filed House Bill No. 11642 or the Prohibition of Floating Status and Protection of Continuity Act on Wednesday. The move comes amid the growing concerns of “floating status” practice in the business process outsourcing (BPO) industry.
